response.what_it_is: White PlayStation 4 Slim console with two wireless controllers in boxes
hidden_risks: Controller authenticity (counterfeit DualShock 4 controllers are widespread)
Console internal dust, fan noise, and port functionality
Hard drive capacity and health status
Validity and accessibility of the 15 installed games (account locks or firmware bans)
response.best_proof: A clear photo of the console's rear ports and the bottom model/serial number sticker
response.failure_mode: Assuming the bundled controllers are genuine original Sony accessories and the advertised games are fully playable and accessible.
